answers.how: The eagle moves about 156 px between 1 s and 2 s. Its known speed and camera distances imply a focal scale of approximately 2370 px. A roughly 20 px horizontal extent at about 144 m gives a length of 1.2 m.

Using the eagle-calibrated focal scale of approximately 2370 px, the boat's full height, including the antenna, measures about 174–177 px. Applying the supplied boat distances gives approximately 9.8 m.
The boat measures approximately 145 px long at 1 s and 151 px at 2 s. Converting with the eagle-calibrated focal scale and the respective boat distances gives approximately 8.3 m.
Tracking the boat around 1 s gives a transverse speed of approximately 3.05 m/s after perspective correction. Combining this with its approximately 2.74 m/s radial motion gives a speed of 4.1 m/s.
